scope: Public mobile Step 13 preparation only; physical acceptance and integration pending

candidates.installed_physical_identity: last recorded build 59; current installed identity must be reverified

checks.title: Installed identity and upgrade
checks.procedure: Record actual phone/iOS, installed bundle/source/build and signed artifact hash, signing method/expiry, prior build and paired desktop/source/hash. Back up through the existing trusted process. Upgrade over the same com.bigbenkenobi.tinker-companion identity without uninstalling; verify Notes/Tasks/Calendar, unsent outbox and Keychain pairing retained. Stop on identity mismatch or unsupported recovery.

checks.title: Offline and reconnect
checks.procedure: Create/edit/delete offline, relaunch then reconnect; durable outbox replays once, cursor advances after commit, IDs/tombstones/graphs/order preserved. Record pending counts and final synthetic record states on both peers; interrupted sync, failure/cancel/retry cannot discard work.

checks.title: Stale drafts and raced conflicts
checks.procedure: Open stale editors, change records on peer, race save/delete and reconnect; conflicts preserve both versions and drafts. Explicit review resolution removes only resolved conflicts; bounded pages eventually expose all conflicts without quiet-sync scans.

checks.title: Calendar and Files
checks.procedure: Multiple calendars, recurring events and exceptions, selected-calendar ICS export/import through Files, duplicate/replacement preview, pending edits/deletes and change-after-preview, malformed/overflow alarm data: correct membership and reminder ownership, reject invalid data atomically and preserve originals/drafts.

checks.title: Permissions and pairing
checks.procedure: Reminder ownership, granted/denied/revoked notification/local-network permissions, TLS pin mismatch, failed pairing, revoked peer and re-pair: clear feedback without data loss or credential leakage. Keychain is the only bearer store; record no tokens or QR text.

checks.title: Accessibility and resource use
checks.procedure: VoiceOver, keyboard where available, large Dynamic Type, small/large layout, foreground/background transitions, offline/quiet sync and battery observation. Record device, dataset size, duration, energy/memory/MainActor/storage/recurrence evidence; real-device restructuring remains issue #5, not an inferred performance pass.

checks.title: Signing refresh and review
checks.procedure: Use the established owner signing/refresh procedure, retain same bundle identity and repeat renewal; confirm pairing, records and outbox survive. Record real expiry and renewals. Review sanitized screenshots and observed outcomes for the changed candidate before expiry; simulator screenshots or historical owner reports cannot accept this build.

checks.title: Hosted desktop
checks.procedure: Owner resolves issue #19 account billing/spending gate, then Python 3.11/3.12 jobs actually execute and pass on the identified candidate; paired mobile small/large gates pass. Local Qt-offscreen success cannot substitute.

checks.title: Evidence and scope
checks.procedure: Preserve curated logs/manifests/approved sanitized captures and original comparisons durably before artifact expiry. Every required selected-scope cell has observed result/reviewer; PLAN and the 55-feature ledger remain authoritative. Record explicit deferred IDs/unsupported environments, not blanket product acceptance.

checks.title: Owner decisions and integration
checks.procedure: Record owner license/distribution/support/security channels, exact accepted candidate pair and separate acceptance/integration/protection/tag/release/signing authorization. Pending owner decisions and physical gates keep release readiness blocked.
